title: John Lennon appears on the Helping Hand Marathon in Philadelphia | 1975
content:
John Lennon took part in the WFIL-AM Helping Hand Marathon charity fundraiser on in Philadelphia, USA, on 16 May 1975.

Lennon travelled by train from New York City to Philly, and took part in the event over this and the next two days. He read out pledges on air, sold his socks for $50, and signed autographs for donations outside the studio. He also guest presented the weather on WPVI Channel 6’s Action News.

The Helping Hand Marathon ended at midnight on Sunday 18 May. The event raised over $110,000.
